description_en: 2+1+2 apartment for sale and a parking post on ruga e Kosovarve, new building, floor 6, with a total area of ​​120 m2 and a net area of ​​105. It is organized in a small corridor, a spacious living room, two bedrooms where the matrimonial one has a wardrobe and an internal toilet with natural ventilation, two toilets, a laundry room and two balconies. The apartment is completely furnished with architect and quality materials and is offered furnished as in the photo. The building in which it is located is one of the best in the area and with a good quality of construction. For more information or a visit to the property, do not hesitate to contact me.
